analysis.narrative:
📊 **Consensus:** Bearish with medium conviction. Near-term headwinds from regulatory uncertainty (stablecoin enforcement, DOJ speculation), financial sector weakness (credit card issuers down 3-11%), and crypto leverage unwinding dominate immediate sentiment, though institutional infrastructure buildout (derivatives, prediction markets) and mega-cap tech resilience provide selective support.

📈 **Themes:** (1) Crypto infrastructure bifurcation - institutional capital flowing into derivatives/prediction markets while retail-driven assets face regulatory pressure and exchange security concerns; (2) Financial sector distress from credit card rate cap proposals creating defensive rotation into mega-cap technology; (3) Monetary policy uncertainty with Fed rate cut expectations diverging from concrete timeline, constraining risk appetite across consumer discretionary and traditional banking.

🎯 **Levels:** SPY ($694.07): Call Wall $700 (45k OI, 0.9% away - ACTIVE resistance), Put Wall $630 (149k OI, 9.2% away - dormant). Max Pain $693. Near support: $680 (125k OI - ACTIVE). QQQ ($626.65): Call Wall $627 (57k OI, 0.1% away - ACTIVE resistance), Put Wall $574.78 (116k OI). Max Pain $625. Near resistance: $641 (56k OI), $650 (42k OI). /ES: 6847 support per Twitter sources.
